summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Seventh Supplemental Indenture governing $750M of 6.350% notes due 2033. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. The notes are unsecured obligations, rank pari passu with other unsecured debt, and include standard change-of-control repurchase provisions. No special-situation elements such as M&A, tender offer, or restructuring are present.
